verdict: Landed sharing meets the cell request/outcome repeated-large-value outcome; no product change.
backend: SQLite file; production durable engine, TypeScript subprocess worker
scope: admission-to-turn.commit; excludes facade send/observation; no wall-time or optimization-speedup claim
method: Temporary probes at SQLite graph.rs and pages.rs absent-node insertion sites, joined by SQL Window operation to accepted recorder transactions; sums match maintained newly_installed_graph_bytes for every operation. Counts include insertions after GC. Not recorder first-seen counts, staged bytes, SQL bind bytes, allocated database file size or WAL bytes.

units.installed_bytes: canonical graph-node envelope bytes actually newly inserted in accepted commits
units.by_kind: numeric registry kind to installed canonical bytes
units.instructions: whole-process user instructions, worker descendants and probes included; two batches per process
units.peak_rss_kib: /usr/bin/time -v process/descendant maximum; not summed simultaneous RSS

patterns: fresh: x (P-1) times followed by decimal await index, 0..9; empty at P=0
workload.retention: all echoed answers remain in the guest kept array
workload.archive_validation: After every turn, committed_turns_with_tool_calls returns exactly N ordered calls; every args equals {i, pad}; every typed ToolCallOutput equals success(args), including output metadata.
workload.freshness: fresh within one batch only; batch 1 repeats batch 0 values and is explicitly warm
workload.failure_population: No failing effects in this echo fixture. No runtime/storage/codec/host code changes retained, so typed failures and their order remain unchanged; no failure-injection proof claimed.

conclusion.request_kind: FrozenRequest=19: 198 bytes per large-value admission on cold batches
conclusion.archive_kind: CallBody=40: 192 bytes per large-value settled call, independent of 1/16 KiB pad
conclusion.necessary_other_bytes: Initial source/doc/heap leaves and exact model/prompt spellings remain; per-call structural nodes grow. These are individually attributed, not mistaken for request/outcome value duplication.
